title: Generated grocery reference
summary: Upload a separately generated reference and compare its extracted layout with P01.

title: Generated semiconductor reference
summary: Upload a separately generated line reference; inspect equipment masks and occlusion.
prompt: Create a single coherent architectural reference image of an illustrative semiconductor packaging and test assembly line, elevated three-quarter interior view. Show seven distinct equipment stations in sequence for wafer loading, die attach, wire bonding, encapsulation, singulation, electrical test and packaged output. Include small buffer areas, a clear transport aisle and clean-room-style white and stainless surfaces. No workers, no readable signage, no impossible overlapping equipment, no collage. title: Generated zoo reference
summary: Upload a generated zoo reference; inspect paths, enclosures and vegetation.
prompt: Create a single coherent elevated three-quarter architectural reference image of a small illustrative zoo. Include an entrance plaza, savanna habitat, aviary, woodland enclosure and aquatic habitat arranged around a continuous looping visitor path. Clearly distinguish safe visitor routes from fenced habitats; show planting and a few small static animals. Diffuse daylight, visible enclosure boundaries, no readable labels, no people, no collage. This is a conceptual design rather than a real zoo.
